quests.question: She was ___ the phone for over an hour.
quests.hint: 'On the phone' is a fixed expression.
quests.explanation: 'On the phone' is the standard expression for speaking via telephone: she was on the phone.

quests.question: He spends hours ___ the internet every day.
quests.hint: 'On the internet' is the standard expression.
quests.explanation: 'On the internet' is the standard: surf on the internet, shop on the internet, find something on the internet.

quests.question: She saw the advertisement ___ television.
quests.hint: 'On television' is the fixed expression.
quests.explanation: 'On television' or 'on TV' is the standard: watch something on television, see something on TV.

quests.question: He read about the accident ___ the newspaper.
quests.hint: 'In the newspaper' - text that is inside a printed publication.
quests.explanation: 'In' is used for publications: in the newspaper, in a magazine, in a book.

quests.question: She heard about it ___ the radio.
quests.hint: 'On the radio' is the standard expression.
quests.explanation: 'On the radio' is the fixed expression for broadcasting: hear something on the radio, play music on the radio.

quests.question: The message arrived ___ email.
quests.hint: 'By email' means using email as a means of communication.
quests.explanation: 'By email' follows the pattern 'by + means of communication': by email, by post, by phone.

quests.question: She is ___ a diet and avoiding sugar.
quests.hint: 'On a diet' is the fixed expression.
quests.explanation: 'On a diet' is the standard: go on a diet, be on a diet.

quests.question: He went to the hospital ___ a broken arm.
quests.hint: 'Go to hospital with an injury' - 'with' introduces the condition.
quests.explanation: 'With' introduces the condition or injury: admitted with a broken arm, went in with pneumonia.

quests.question: She is recovering ___ a difficult operation.
quests.hint: 'Recover from' an illness or operation.
quests.explanation: 'Recover from' is the standard pattern: recover from surgery, recover from an illness, recover from a setback.

quests.question: He suffers ___ severe headaches.
quests.hint: 'Suffer from' an illness or condition is the correct collocation.
quests.explanation: 'Suffer from' is the standard medical expression: suffer from diabetes, suffer from anxiety.

quests.question: She complained ___ her doctor about the side effects.
quests.hint: 'Complain to someone' - 'to' identifies the recipient.
quests.explanation: 'Complain to' the person receiving the complaint: complain to the manager, complain to the doctor.

quests.question: He was treated ___ an infection at the clinic.
quests.hint: 'Treated for' an illness or condition.
quests.explanation: 'Treat for' is the standard medical expression: treated for pneumonia, treated for a fracture.

quests.question: She works ___ a freelance basis.
quests.hint: 'On a freelance basis' is the fixed professional expression.
quests.explanation: 'On a basis' is a fixed pattern: on a full-time basis, on a part-time basis, on a freelance basis.

quests.question: He left the company ___ his own free will.
quests.hint: 'At his own free will' or 'of his own free will' - the idiomatic form is 'of his own free will'.
quests.explanation: 'Of your own free will' means voluntarily. However, 'at his own discretion' uses 'at'. The correct idiomatic phrase here is 'of'.

quests.question: She was promoted ___ the position of senior manager.
quests.hint: 'Promoted to a position' is the correct collocation.
quests.explanation: 'Promoted to' a position or rank: promoted to manager, promoted to director.

quests.question: He is very good ___ dealing with complaints.
quests.hint: 'Good at' a skill or activity.
quests.explanation: 'Good at' is the correct dependent preposition with an activity: good at managing, good at coding.

quests.question: She is skilled ___ data analysis.
quests.hint: 'Skilled at' or 'skilled in' - 'at' with activities is most natural.
quests.explanation: 'Skilled at' or 'skilled in' are both used. 'Skilled at' is more natural with specific activities.

quests.question: He has a lot of experience ___ project management.
quests.hint: 'Experience in a field' is the standard collocation.
quests.explanation: 'Experience in' a field or area: experience in sales, experience in teaching, experience in management.

quests.question: She was deeply affected ___ the news.
quests.hint: 'Affected by' is the standard passive pattern.
quests.explanation: 'Affected by' is used to show the cause of an emotional impact: deeply affected by the news, affected by the decision.

quests.question: He is very motivated ___ the challenge.
quests.hint: 'Motivated by' something shows what drives a person.
quests.explanation: 'Motivated by' is the standard form: motivated by success, motivated by passion, motivated by the challenge.

quests.question: She was overwhelmed ___ the number of messages.
quests.hint: 'Overwhelmed by' the cause is the standard form.
quests.explanation: 'Overwhelmed by' is used to show the cause: overwhelmed by work, overwhelmed by the response.

quests.question: He divided the work equally ___ the team.
quests.hint: 'Among the team' - distributing to more than two people.
quests.explanation: 'Among' is used when distributing to a group of more than two: divided among the team.

quests.question: The price is ___ the range of most customers.
quests.hint: 'Within a range' means inside the limits of something.
quests.explanation: 'Within the range' means inside the boundaries: within budget, within the price range, within limits.

quests.question: Her scores are ___ the class average.
quests.hint: 'Below the average' means lower than the average value.
quests.explanation: 'Below the average' is the standard: below average, below the threshold, below the standard.

quests.question: She is ___ her way to the station.
quests.hint: 'On her way to' is the fixed expression.
quests.explanation: 'On the way to' is a fixed expression: on her way to work, on his way home.

quests.question: He has been ___ a business trip all week.
quests.hint: 'On a business trip' is a fixed expression.
quests.explanation: 'On a trip' is a fixed pattern: on a business trip, on a school trip, on a tour.

quests.question: She is ___ a conference in Vienna.
quests.hint: 'At a conference' means attending or present at it.
quests.explanation: 'At a conference' or 'at an event' means present and attending. 'In' would suggest she is inside the building.

quests.question: He lives ___ the outskirts of the city.
quests.hint: 'On the outskirts of' is the fixed locative expression.
quests.explanation: 'On the outskirts of' is the fixed phrase: on the outskirts of the city, on the outskirts of town.

quests.question: She graduated ___ the top of her class.
quests.hint: 'At the top of the class' - position in ranking.
quests.explanation: 'At the top of her class' means she was the highest ranked student.

quests.question: He completed the project ___ schedule.
quests.hint: 'On schedule' means according to the planned timetable.
quests.explanation: 'On schedule' is a fixed expression: completed on schedule, delivered on time, finished on budget.
